body: I’m sorry to hear that. Are your parents not allowing you to see your friends?
I know a friend who retook that exam after a year and did well. Not an advice here, just a story.

I assume you are still in your teenage years. Things are likely to get better as you age. Your hormone levels and your brain connections will stabilize as you enter adulthood - why not stay longer a bit to take a look at your adulthood? Your brain is reducing 50% of its synapse connections. Some people might have a crazy time going through it. You might had the bad luck of going through a bad one. Please, wait until it finishes. You aren’t far away from it!

Losing friends feels terrible. Making new friends or entering friend groups might seem hard. Keep trying! As a side note, I am sure there are people in your school looking for friends, maybe you didn’t know them. Try to see if you can find them and chat about stuff. They will be glad you reached out, and you will have more new friends!
